# Resource estimates for the shipped study files

`femem run --estimate <file>` on every study file under `examples/` and every study fence (```` ```yaml <tag> ````) under `docs/guide/`, printed with no solve. Launch width: `mpiexec -n 2` -- `--estimate` prices the current launch width, so `ranks` and `predicted_seconds` are this width's. Each value is the CLI's printed `repr`, asserted equal to `Study.estimate` (`tests/package/test_wf17_estimate_table_page.py`).

The tier is the tier **by prediction**: `xl` when ranks > 12 or predicted seconds > 1200; otherwise the smallest of smoke (30 s), standard (180 s) and heavy (1200 s) that covers the predicted seconds. It is not a measurement.

## Measured 1.5 T box-window prices beside the estimator

The estimator's 1.5 T row (FC1, `ranks` 16) was measured on the F-clinical-1.5T r1 mesh (no rod) and its seconds are one EM solve with the mesh build excluded; `xl` entries 48, 52 and 59 ran the rod-in-box 1.5 T mesh (tag 403 as each row states) at `-n 8`, their seconds are whole-window wall times (build, EM solve and readouts) and their GiB the cgroup `memory.peak`. The ratios therefore set two different quantities, on two meshes, at two widths, beside each other. Measured values are the strings of `docs/testing/xl-ledger.md`; the estimator values are the CLI's printed `repr` of `femem run --estimate tests/package/wf13/f_clinical_15t.yaml`.

## Measured 3 T degree-2 price beside the estimator

`xl` entry 64 ran the F-clinical-3T r1 coil mesh (no box, tag 403 absent) at degree 2 at `-n 16`; its seconds are the whole-window wall time (build, the Z50 pair and three node pairs) and its GiB the cgroup `memory.peak`. The estimator's 3 T degree-2 row FC4 is not priced (`Study.estimate` prints its `not_priced` `repr`), so its ratios are `nan`. FC3 (degree 1) was measured on the same mesh at the same width, so its ratio sets the degree-1 estimator beside the degree-2 window: one mesh, one width, two degrees, two quantities. ## Measured degree-2 clinical prices beside the estimator

The estimator's degree-2 1.5 T row (FC2, `ranks` 16) was measured on the F-clinical-1.5T r1 mesh (no rod) and its seconds are one EM solve with the mesh build excluded; `xxl` entry 62 ran the rod-in-box 1.5 T mesh at degree 2 at `-n 16` in two calls in one window -- call 1 C6 with the box-wide grid, call 2 I36 in two arms (tag 403 as each row states). Each call's seconds are that call's window (build, EM solves and readouts), the window's seconds the harness wall time, and the GiB the cgroup `memory.peak` over the whole window, so the call rows carry no GiB and no GiB ratio. The ratios therefore set two different quantities, on two meshes, at one width, beside each other. Measured values are the strings of `docs/testing/xxl-ledger.md`; the estimator values are the CLI's printed `repr` of `femem run --estimate tests/package/wf13/f_clinical_15t_d2.yaml`.
